method.timing: Wall-clock milliseconds on host; methods inclusive; do not add inclusive method totals.
method.memory: maxRSS is process high-water including warmup and worker isolates. Heap samples are observed lower bounds, not allocation deltas or per-function peaks.
method.heap: 32 KiB allocation sampling, live sampled objects only; freed transient objects and allocation peaks UNKNOWN.
method.equivalence: All runNight return fields including selected-cycle traces; replay final snapshots include events. Not a same-phase device twin.
